public_rationale: Operator and Pulse demonstrate the continuing practice under the stated reading. Operator moved from its January Pro preview to the July Plus rollout, while Pulse remained Pro-only nearly three months after its September preview. These access restrictions kept the combined broad, accessible and dependable endpoint unmet for months. Deep research reached Plus much sooner, so the evidence supports a recurring practice, not a claim about every launch. The optional suggestion of years is not established.
limitations: The result depends on treating premium Pro-only previews as short of ordinary broad consumer access.
The evidence establishes delays to the combined endpoint, not separate multi-month delays in every aspect of reliability, geography and price.
No multi-year delay is needed or demonstrated.

Treat access through an ordinary consumer tier as potentially accessible and a premium Pro-only preview as restricted access. This affordability distinction is an evaluator judgment.
Product subscription prices are access criteria here, not a claim about OpenAI's revenue or other financial accounts.
